card.name: Verb or 'to' after subject in old prose
card.fires_on: The small word 'to' or a form of 'be' (is, are, was) right after a subject or adjective, in older formal books on law, history or anatomy. It marks where a verb phrase is about to follow.

modes.label: Infinitive 'to'
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'expedient', 'used', 'is' or 'steps', leading into an action verb.
